special_situations.headline: Newspaper publication of commencement of the pre-packaged insolvency resolution process.
special_situations.summary: Newspaper notice formalizing pre-pack insolvency process commencement under IBC.
special_situations.impact: Not a monetary event; signals formal PPIRP now underway ahead of NCLT approval for amalgamation with Onix Renewable.
special_situations.risk: Existing equity dilution/write-off risk typical in pre-pack resolutions
special_situations.view_reasoning: Company already in formal insolvency with a proposed amalgamation; FY26 PAT collapsed to ₹0.20 Cr from ₹2.14 Cr.

special_situations.headline: Resignation of Statutory Auditor - M/S R.B. Jain & Associates
special_situations.summary: Newly appointed 5-year statutory auditor R.B. Jain & Associates resigns shortly after appointment.
special_situations.impact: No transaction size; qualitative governance concern for a recently NCLT-exited shell-like trading company.
special_situations.risk: Rapid auditor turnover post-CIRP raises audit/compliance quality concerns
special_situations.view_reasoning: Auditor appointed May 2026 for a 5-year term resigning within months is unusual and warrants caution for a fragile post-CIRP entity.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt of Letter of Award
special_situations.summary: Won 230 MW in SECI's 1 GW FDRE round-the-clock tender at ₹5.26/unit tariff.
special_situations.impact: ~9% capacity addition (230 MW vs ~2.57 GWp operational base); no fixed order value disclosed, backed by 25-yr PPA.
special_situations.risk: Execution/SCOD delays over 24-month timeline; high leverage
special_situations.view_reasoning: Order win is positive scale growth, but screener flags a low 3-yr ROE (1.07%) and low interest coverage post-IPO.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: We are pleased to inform you that the Company has been Awarded the Letter of award from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) at Madangundi Fee Plaza.
special_situations.summary: NHAI awards ₹28.47 crore toll-collection contract at Madangundi Fee Plaza, Jharkhand.
special_situations.impact: ~4.9% of FY26 revenue (₹28.47 Cr order vs ₹579.58 Cr FY26 consolidated revenue).
special_situations.risk: Recurring small toll orders amid declining FY26 revenue and reported negative operating cashflow
special_situations.view_reasoning: Revenue fell ~9% YoY in FY26 despite margin improvement; steady but small toll wins don't offset core topline decline.

special_situations.headline: Full and Final Settlement w.r.t. Insolvency petition filed against Sherisha Solar LLP and completion of internal restructuring.
special_situations.summary: Settled Sherisha Solar LLP insolvency petition for ₹16.51 Cr against ₹33.39 Cr claimed; case to be withdrawn.
special_situations.impact: ~25% of FY revenue (₹16.51 Cr settlement vs ₹66.5 Cr consolidated revenue), removing a Section 7 IBC overhang on subsidiary.
special_situations.risk: Standalone going-concern flag, promoter pledge 42.7%, stock down ~68% over 1 year
special_situations.view_reasoning: Settlement removes one overhang, but FY loss of ₹43 Cr, going-concern auditor note, and recent director exits signal deeper distress.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: Revised intimation of receipt of letter of award

fallen_ipos.view_reasoning: Promoter stake fell 47%→34.6% post-listing plus heavy fund selling; also hit by weak spinning-sector margins industry-wide.
Q4 profit/revenue fell QoQ on sector margin squeeze, but FY26 revenue grew 26%, Falcon Yarns deal, bonus/dividend intact.
High debt (D/E ~2.3-3x), credit rating downgrade to junk/BBB-, 70% revenue from top 10 customers, Gujarat-only concentration.
